title: Strategy list needs an exclude draft filter with per state counts
summary: Added exclude_state=draft filtering, state=retired and state=review support, unknown lifecycle preservation under exclude_state=draft, and single-read tenant-scoped meta.state_counts across Registry and BFF strategy list surfaces.

details: Extended GET /api/registry/strategy-specs?view=strategy_summary_page and project_strategy_spec_summary_page to accept exclude_state (e.g. exclude_state=draft), reject state + exclude_state combined with HTTP 400, support state=retired (while default and exclude_state=draft continue to exclude retired strategies), and support state=review / candidate.

Added _extract_strategy_summary_raw_lifecycle so strategies whose stored lifecycle value is not a known state (or whose non-draft lifecycle state is stored in strategy_spec/metadata while artifact_state is draft) retain their raw lifecycle value instead of being collapsed to 'draft' and hidden by exclude_state=draft.

Added compute_strategy_spec_state_counts to compute per-DTO-state counts (draft, review, approved, paper_running, canary_running, live_running, deployed, paused, retired) across the caller tenant's current strategy families in the same single bounded SQL leaf-projection pass, returning state_counts=None if count computation fails.

Updated GET /bff/strategies to accept exclude_state, reject non-empty state + exclude_state together with HTTP 400 VALIDATION_FAILED, and forward exclude_state to StrategiesService.list_strategy_summaries_page and DefaultResearchKnowledgeSourcePort.list_strategy_specs_page.

Attached meta.state_counts from the single bounded owner summary-page read (or in-memory summary fallback when owner_page is None). When state_counts is absent, null, malformed, or raises an error, meta.state_counts is null (None) and never zeros while GET /bff/strategies still returns HTTP 200.
Preserved exact existing items and page_info.total behavior when exclude_state is omitted.
Supported state=retired and state=review across owner-backed, injected-spec, and fallback paths, and ensured unknown stored lifecycle values remain visible under exclude_state=draft.

ac7_no_existing_test_weakened_or_deleted.justification: No existing test assertion was weakened or deleted. In services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_strategy_list_latency.py, _owner_http_stub was extended by one keyword argument (exclude_state=qs['exclude_state'][0] if 'exclude_state' in qs else None) so the test stub forwards exclude_state to reg_service.strategy_spec_summary_page; all existing assertions in test_strategy_list_latency.py are unchanged.
